name: fac-facilitator-retro
description: Turns a fifteen-minute, six-question debrief by the trainer or the delivery team into a half-page retro note and a table of timing corrections per activity, process only. Use for "run fac-facilitator-retro", "facilitator retro", "debrief the session", "trainer self reflection", "what would I change next time", "after action review for a workshop", "lessons learned from the training", "that session went sideways", part of the Claude for Trainers and Facilitators Pack by 90n.
